[[Elegant Menzies]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped from the [[Chest of Woe]] as of the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20260729|July 29, 2026 update]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:[[Health]] +45 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Armor]] +10 (vs. [[Blunt]] damage)

==Acquisition==
;[[Core]]
*[[The Fissure of Woe]]
**[[Chest of Woe]]

==Skin==
It has the same skin as an [[Oppressor's Shield]] dyed black.

==Replica==
Except for the [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas provide core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*[[Oppressor's Shield]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Shield Handle]] [[of Devotion]] 
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Not the face!]]" inscription
*[[Black Dye]]
